Romi (PM): Quick sync: experimenting with a single-tap approve on mobile for prompt-set evals. Idea: long-press to open confirm, tap to approve (with undo). Want to keep desktop parity via a keyboard gesture. Prototype link: https://figma.com/compact-approve-mobile
Gabe (Design): Love reducing friction. Concern: accidental taps. Suggest visible affordance: a small rounded approve button with subtle confirmation animation + undo snackbar. Also propose a compact confirm sheet on mobile that shows failing tests count before final approve.
Sumi (Frontend): Implementation notes: for mobile, use 300ms long-press to open quick confirm. For desktop, double-tap is awkward; propose keyboard shortcut 'A' to approve current focus, or space+enter pattern to reduce accidental triggers. We'll need optimistic UI and a 10s undo window for all platforms.
Ana (A11y): Accessibility: long-press is inaccessible for keyboard users. Must provide an equivalent like a modal opened via a keyboard action. Ensure the confirm sheet is focus-trapped and has aria-labelledby. Announce approve result with aria-live region: e.g., "3 tests approved". Undo must be reachable via keyboard and announced too.
Tess (QA): QA notes: block approve if any selected test has regression >1.8% or is flagged flaky. For mobile quick-approve, show a small badge if overrides are required. Also test behavior when network stalls (show pending state and prevent duplicate submits).
Romi (PM): Copy suggestions: approve button = "Approve"; mobile confirm CTA = "Confirm approve"; undo toast = "Undo". For override flow: modal title = "Approve with overrides"; require a short reason when overriding failing tests.
Gabe (Design): I'll add a tiny failure badge that appears inline with count ("2 failing") and a color + icon not reliant on color alone. Also add animation for the snackbar to make it obvious on mobile.
Sumi (Frontend): Backend needs endpoint that returns run-summary with counts: {total, failing_count, flaky_count, blocked_by_threshold}. Also need POST /runs/:id/bulk-approve with optional override_reason. ETA for proto: 48 hours. Frontend prototype in ~5 days with mobile gesture + keyboard mapping.
Ana (A11y): Keyboard mapping proposal: j/k navigate, Enter expand, A = approve focused, Shift+A = approve selection with confirm. Provide a setting to disable gesture shortcuts for users who want cleaner keyboard bindings. I'll write an a11y checklist for the PR.
Tess (QA): Edge cases: 1) approving while run is re-evaluating -> show lock and prevent action; 2) flaky tests excluded from bulk approve by default; 3) conflicting approvals -> surface a small conflict banner on next load. We'll add automated tests for network retries and undo behavior.
review-bot: preview built -> https://preview.redwood.ai/runs/1965432100/quick-approve; branch -> github.com/redwood/repo/pull/811
Romi (PM): Plan: Gabe + Sumi pair on prototype, Ana owns a11y checklist, Tess will add testcases. We'll demo at Friday crit. Thanks! :rocket:
